about:
Wilkins Lumber Co. Inc. operates a small family-owned sawmill in Milford, New Hampshire, a business that has been providing native wood products to the Souhegan Valley since 1808. The mill has survived the Great Depression, a fire, and a lightning strike in the early 1900s, remaining under family stewardship for over two centuries.

The company offers a log-to-lumber service that begins with selective harvesting for local timberland owners. Its sawmill processes New Hampshire hemlock and pine, turning every scrap into competitively priced lumber products. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Wilkins Lumber serves local timberland owners and regional buyers throughout Southern New Hampshire, supplying native lumber for construction, woodworking, and other wood-product applications. The mill’s customer base is rooted in the Souhegan Valley and surrounding communities.

The company attributes its longevity to dedication, perseverance, and hard work, emphasizing its commitment to continuing the supply of native wood into the 21st century. Its family-owned structure and historical resilience are presented as key differentiators.
